title: MATKP Team
dataPoints:
Name,Affiliation,Role,Photo
Kyle Gaulton,"University of California, San Diego (UCSD)","Dr. Gaulton develops the meta-data and data library, creates high-value resources from data, and performs integrated analyses of these data and resources to provide results and knowledge to the community. He is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/KJG.0310%20-%20Kyle%20J%20Gaulton.jpg
Steve Parker,University of Michigan,"Dr. Parker translates high-quality multi-modal data into accessible knowledge. In addition to general project management, he contributes to quality control, data analytics, computational integration, visualization, and biological interpretation. He is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/Parker_Stephen.JPG
Anna L Gloyn,Stanford University,"Dr. Gloyn has a background in human genetics and islet biology. Within PanKbase, she co-leads efforts to identify data sources for PanKBase and harmonization of donor meta-data, genomic and genotyping efforts across resources. As a current member of the Human Pancreas Analysis Program (HPAP) and the director of the Human Islet Genotyping Initiative (HIGI) for the Integrated Islet Distribution Program (IIDP) she also facilitates coordination and integration between these major HIRN efforts. She is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/ANNA%20BRC-HIGH%20RESOLUTION%20-%20Anna%20Louise%20Gloyn.jpg
Marcela Brissova,Vanderbilt University Medical Center,"Dr. Brissova has extensive expertise in islet biology, tissue imaging and analysis, and physiology, along with active collaborations in islet and pancreas mapping projects. In this initiative, she will spearhead partnerships with other NIDDK-funded programs, leveraging her established leadership roles in the field to oversee data curation and community engagement efforts for the PanKbase team. She will work closely with a team of data curators and analysts to identify and connect with scientists and existing datasets, aiming to build an impactful database that offers accessible data visualization and analysis tools. She is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/Brissova_Marcela.jpg
Noël Burtt,Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard,Ms. Burtt is the director of operations and development of the Diabetes Research & Knowledge Portals in the Medical and Population Genetics Program and Metabolism Program at the Broad Institute. She is responsible for developing the PanKbase portal platform. She is one of the PanKbase MPIs.,https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/Noel_burtt.png
Jie Liu,University of Michigan,"Dr. Liu leads the development of PanKgraph, the knowledge graph component in PanKbase, and co-leads the data and metadata working group. He is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/liu_square%20-%20Jie%20Liu.png
Jason Flannick,Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard,"Dr. Flannick is an assistant professor of pediatrics at Harvard Medical School and the Division of Genetics and Genomics at Boston Children’s Hospital, and an associate member of the Broad Institute. His lab develops computational approaches to use genomic data to understand or better treat human diseases, with a current focus on diabetes. He is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/Jason_flannick.png
Jean-Philippe Cartailler,Vanderbilt University,"Dr. Cartallier advises and assists on matters pertaining to platform design, data standards and QC, data interoperability, and user experience. He is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/JP-Cartailler-square%20-%20jp.cartailler%40vanderbilt.edu_.jpg
Ben Voight,University of Pennsylvania ,"Dr. Voight lends statistical and data science intuition and skills, experiences in pipeline development, and data curation, as well as general knowledge of genetics and genomics of diabetes. He is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/ben-voight%20-%20Benjamin%20Voight.jpg
Michael L. Stitzel,The Jackson Laboratory,"Dr. Stitzel brings nearly 20 years' interest in understanding the genetic programming of human islet identity and function using functional (epi)genomic tools and approaches. He helps coordinate islet genetic and genomic data acquisition, quality control, and interpretation/use case development. He is one of the PanKbase MPIs.",https://hugeampkpncms.org/sites/default/files/images/pankbase/Stitzel_headshot%20-%20Michael%20S..jpg
